decision: CORRECTION to the source proposal: do NOT amend 2026-06-05-002 — it is closed (completed 6/6, committed); amending a closed plan by adding a feature breaks locked-AC discipline. This is a NEW plan building on 002's shipped pieces (qa-sufficiency-contract.md, surface_proof_missing lint, surface tagging).

Kept SEPARATE from the dashboard UI remediation (plan 2026-06-05-003). This is orchestrator governance (plan-review/CLI surface); that is product UI. The two are complementary: this gate would have forced the dashboard plans to dispose the design-system + real-shell-journey conventions, surfacing the gap; 003 fixes the actual UI debt + provides the standard this gate's frontend pack references.

v0 is WARN-only. BLOCK escalation for user-facing/mutation surfaces is deferred (demand-gated, needs false-positive data first) — mirrors 2026-06-05-002 F006's advisory-first stance and the broader demand-driven-v2 pattern.

Seed ONLY the dashboard/frontend pack as the concrete worked example; the other 7 surface packs (backend-api, mobile-ios, mobile-android, cli, agent-mcp, external-integration, infra-deploy) are NAMED stubs with empty item lists. Their content is demand-gated — authored when a plan in that surface needs it. This avoids building the whole 8-pack framework up front.

Reuse existing modules rather than a new framework: derive_surfaces extends plan_review/lint.py surface tagging; the advisory check follows the sufficiency_gate.py wiring pattern; skill_applicability.py is bridged from advisory-only into the disposition ledger (the explicit awareness->accountability upgrade the proposal calls for).

REVIEW FIX (biggest gap — canonical taxonomy): added F001 as a load-bearing canonical surface vocabulary + alias map folding the four non-matching vocabularies (plan-review lint tags, qa-sufficiency surface classes, skill applies_to values, agent-conventions topics) into one closed set; unknown inputs -> explicit unrouteable. Seed table fixed in plan.md (frontend-ui/command/backend-api/mobile-app/agent-tool/infra-deploy/security-review/mutation). Derivation (F002) now resolves through it so awareness routes to the right standard (e.g. web/ux + dashboard both -> frontend-ui).

REVIEW FIX ('all skills' completeness): skill-applicability silently skips skills whose SKILL.md lacks applies_to. F003 now emits an unrouteable inventory LISTING such skills, so 'all skills considered' is visible, not assumed. v0 only ensures visibility; auto-routing metadata-less skills is out of scope.
REVIEW FIX (ledger storage): the disposition ledger lives in a dedicated per-plan file docs/plans/<id>/conventions.json (NOT a features.json field), to avoid bloating feature records. Fixed in F004.

REVIEW FIX (applied-without-evidence too soft): in v0 an applied disposition lacking an evidence reference is a WARN (not silently ok); BLOCK for user-facing/mutation/security surfaces deferred to v1. Fixed in F004/F005.

REVIEW FIX (synthetic dogfood insufficient): F006 now dogfoods on BOTH a synthetic incomplete plan AND one real historical plan fixture (the dashboard plan that missed the design-system disposition), proving the gate would have caught a real failure.

REVIEW ACK (backend/mobile/cli named-not-governed): stated plainly in the scope boundary — v0 does NOT solve backend/mobile/CLI/agent/external/infra sufficiency; it builds the registry shape + canonical mapping and seeds only the frontend pack. The rest are demand-gated stubs.

F005 DONE: plan_review/disposition_check.check_plan_dispositions (pure, warn-only) wired into cli.py _plan_review_main via _print_disposition_advisory. OPT-IN: fires only for plans that DECLARE surfaces (loaded.surfaces); text-mode only; never changes verdict/exit code. Keeps 004's own plan-review clean (surfaces=[]). A declared-frontend plan with no conventions.json emits 6 advisories.

F006 DONE: conventions_gate.evaluate_plan_dispositions wires F001-F005 end-to-end + bridges matched skills into expected ledger items (skill:<name>). Dogfooded on TWO committed fixtures under evidence/dogfood/: historical-dashboard-no-disposition (NO conventions.json -> warns on design-system-consistency + real-shell-journey-proof = the exact real miss) and synthetic-incomplete (disposes 2/6 -> warns on 4); fully-disposed -> clean. Proves the gate WOULD have caught the dashboard design gap.

PLAN 004 CLOSED completed 6/6. Operator-style TDD, no paid volley. Full orchestrate sweep 3983 passed/7 skipped (+51 new tests, zero regressions). Two commits (63537fe phase-1 + this). Branch chore/plan-ledger-reconciliation-2026-06-04 UNMERGED. Deferred: BLOCK escalation (user-facing/mutation/security), auto disposition inference, cross-repo sync, authoring backend/mobile/cli/agent/external/infra packs (demand-gated stubs).

title: Conventions gate — clarify integration status (F006 component-complete, integration incomplete)
body: F006 is component-complete: the bridge converts matched skills into expected ledger items and has module-level tests. The public CLI currently checks surface dispositions but does not consume this bridge. The earlier “end-to-end” completion wording overstates integration. Integrated capability remains incomplete until the public entry point checks matched-skill dispositions and a regression test demonstrates that behavior. This entry clarifies status; it does not authorize implementation or alter existing approval boundaries. Basis: docs/reviews/2026-09-05-unreached-module-classification.md.
